suite_name: DAVESROUTER OpenBoards — pinned open-source KiCad projects
notes: Open-source KiCad 6+ projects from many repositories, each pinned by commit and Git blob SHA-1 (board and sidecar .kicad_pro/.kicad_dru).
Board bytes are fetched on demand and are not vendored in DAVESROUTER.
Benchmark boards are unrouted derivatives: top-level segments, vias and copper track arcs are stripped after hash verification; zones and rules are kept.
